name: object-classification
title: Object Classification
description: An informal classification of the type of objects within the ObjectGroup, using a hierarchical structure.
notes: This class is used to categorise the ObjectGroup according to an informal, self-referential hierarchy. For example, this can be used to create a hierarchy encompassing biological, geological and anthropological collections, where a single formal taxonomy isn't appropriate.
rdfs:comment: An informal classification of the type of objects within the ObjectGroup, using a hierarchical structure.

fields.name: objectClassification_pk
fields.title: Object Classification (Primary Key)
fields.description: A unique identifier for an ltc:ObjectClassification.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to guarantee uniqueness.
fields.rdfs:comment: A unique identifier for an ltc:ObjectClassification.

fields.name: objectGroup_fk
fields.title: Object Group (Foreign Key)
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key).
fields.rdfs:comment: This property refers to one or more related instances of the ObjectClassification class.

fields.name: parentObjectClassification_fk
fields.title: Object Classification (Foreign Key)
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key).
fields.rdfs:comment: This property refers to one or more related parent instances of the ObjectClassification class.

fields.name: isTopParent
fields.title: Is Top Parent
fields.description: A flag to indicate that the current instance of ObjectClassification is at the top of the hierarchy represented by multiple nested instances of the class.
fields.notes: If this term is used, it should be set to `true` in the instance of ObjectClassification which represents the highest level of a hierarchy and `false` in the rest. If the direction of the hierarchy is self-evident or otherwise not notable, this term should not be populated.
fields.rdfs:comment: A flag to indicate that the current instance of ObjectClassification is at the top of the hierarchy represented by multiple nested instances of the class.

fields.name: objectClassificationLevel
fields.title: Object Classification Level
fields.description: The level of the ObjectClassification in the hierarchy.
fields.notes: It is up to the user to name the levels to be relevant to the hierarchical classification scheme that they are defining.
fields.rdfs:comment: The level of the ObjectClassification in the hierarchy.

fields.name: objectClassificationName
fields.title: Object Classification Name
fields.description: A short title describing this ObjectClassification as a class, unit or grouping.
fields.notes: This is a user-determined name given for classifying their collection. This name, expressing an assigned classification, can be part of a self-referential hierarchy. Use of a controlled vocabulary is recommended, e.g. The GBIF ObjectClassification vocabulary https://registry.gbif.org/vocabulary/ObjectClassificationName
fields.rdfs:comment: A short title describing this ObjectClassification as a class, unit or grouping.
